recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed unless a future PA decision changes the Encounter participant actor target set.
issue_request: FHIR-17914 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request from the STU3 ballot asking to add PractitionerRole to Encounter.participant.individual, in addition to Practitioner, for cases where an encounter participant is a practitioner acting through an organization or team role such as a German ASV team.
initial_application: The request was historically applied by commit 4d97d1578cc45c26fca1afc6fccef344eb8b2fce, whose subject includes GF#17914. Comparing the historical Encounter spreadsheet before and after that commit shows Encounter.participant.individual changed from Reference(Practitioner|RelatedPerson) to Reference(Practitioner|PractitionerRole|RelatedPerson).
additional_context: FHIR-22696 later renamed Encounter.participant.individual to Encounter.participant.actor for R5 and broadened the actor target set while retaining PractitionerRole. The current fhir.ini maps Encounter.participant.individual to Encounter.participant.actor, and Encounter remains active in the resource list. Zulip and PA minutes confirm the ASV-team rationale and the 9-0-0 persuasive PA vote.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml definition for Encounter.participant.actor includes PractitionerRole as a targetProfile, so the current specification already satisfies FHIR-17914 after the later rename.

related_jiras.note: Renamed Encounter.participant.individual to Encounter.participant.actor for R5 and retained PractitionerRole while adding other actor target types.
